description: Two-step chain. Step 1 rebuilds the auto-loan amortization schedule from amount financed, rate, and term. Step 2 checks the disclosed Amount Financed, Finance Charge, and Total of Payments against the recomputed totals under 12 CFR 1026.18. Tolerance follows 12 CFR 1026.18(d)(2): $5 when the amount financed is $1,000 or less, $10 when it is more than $1,000. APR is not checked in v1. Dealer participation is a self-declared assertion, not a detected finding. Federal TILA math only; not legal advice and not a discrimination finding.
name: auto-loan-disclosure-verifier

steps.handoff: Rebuilds the level-payment amortization schedule from the contract terms; totals and schedule digest are cited at step 2.
Checks the disclosed Amount Financed, Finance Charge, and Total of Payments against the step-1 totals and digest. Final stage.

title: Auto-Loan Disclosure Verifier
